issues.desc: background.md Trigger Event and Solution Tradeoffs use S4 and S4-prime as a program/phase designation without ever defining what S4 is or what the prime notation means. An independent reader has no basis to infer the program name or its stage numbering.

background.md Solution Tradeoffs references run-recovery/run-ablation/run-a2prime (e8aca935) where e8aca935 appears to be an identifier (possibly a commit hash) but has no explanation and does not appear in any commit in this repository. Low impact since the do-not-touch constraint is still clear without it.

background.md Conversational Texture uses pre-reg amendment (6->15) where pre-reg is not expanded. An independent reader unfamiliar with experiment pre-registration protocols cannot infer the term. Low impact as it is in the Conversational Texture section and not required to execute the checklist.
